standouts.head: A* setup: wave 2 of wave 3
standouts.text: Five clean waves up from Mar 24 to Jun 26 (+55%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−2.9% to −10%), with the Jun 2 low in the same place. It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from Jul 31, 2025 to Dec 8, 2025 and a pullback of 0.55 of them to the Mar 24 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−20%). A daily close above the wave-1 high (+24%) says wave 3 is under way.
standouts.learn: After five waves up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance. The zone is where to watch; a daily close up inside it is the buy. Under the start of wave 1 the count is wrong.
